Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: SRE pager — payment webhooks and /v1/charges returning quota/billing errors from Stripe. Severity: P1. Customers hitting checkout failures and entitlement checks. Root ts=1790456789

Bryce (on-call): picking this up. Briefly: seeing 429s and 402s from Stripe on both webhook delivery and our billing API calls. Can people paste latest error patterns?

Anika (payments): logs show two patterns: webhook deliveries -> 429 with header X-Stripe-Quota: limit_reached, and API calls to /v1/charges -> 402 with body {"error":{"type":"billing_enforcement","message":"account_quota_enforced"}}. This started ~14:27 UTC.

Maya (support): customer reports — some users can't complete checkout, some are seeing "payment method rejected" when attaching card. Support is triaging high-impact customers.

Bryce (on-call): immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop aggressive webhook retries (turn on exponential backoff), 2) enable cached-entitlement fallback for auth checks, 3) block non-critical billing writes to Stripe (queue them). Who can flip the retry flag?

Sam (on-call-night): I can flip it. Command: `kubectl -n payments set env deploy/webhook-consumer RETRY_STRATEGY=exponential_backoff --record` — will do now.

Incident Bot: Deploy queued: webhook-consumer v3.12.4 -> rollout started by Sam at 14:35 UTC.

Anika (payments): Enabling cached-entitlement fallback: feature flag `payments.cached_entitlements=true`. That will allow login and basic flows; will still block new card attachments and some billing ops. Pushing flag in 2m.

Bryce (on-call): Also temporarily disable immediate billing webhook-triggered account suspends: `billing.suspend_on_failed_charge=false` in config store. This prevents churn while we triage.

Maya (support): Noted. Support will message affected customers with status page link and temporary workaround: try manual retry after 30m, or use saved cards already on file.

Billing Ops: We're opening an account-level support case with Stripe. Drafted message: "Account quota enforcement observed causing 402/billing_enforcement responses across API and webhooks. This is impacting production checkout. Requesting urgent investigation and quota lift or explanation." Ticket created: STR-84021 (internal). Can someone escalate to Stripe live chat?

Anika (payments): I'm on the Stripe Dashboard and I see a billing alert: "Quota enforcement for merchant ID acct_XXXX: usage over commit." There's a note pointing to unpaid overage and a pending invoice. I'm DM'ing Billing Ops to confirm whether there's a billing hold.

Billing Ops: Confirmed — an automated collection attempt failed earlier and account moved into limited mode for API access. We have a pending invoice for $17,400. Payment method on file failed. Initiating recovery with finance now and trying a one-time payment to restore normal API capacity. Escalating to Stripe Support via priority channel.

Stripe Support: (automated reply) Received: case #CS-111332. We see enforcement triggered by collection failure; to restore full capacity pay outstanding invoice or request temporary override. Providing link to payment portal and escalation contact.

Bryce (on-call): Operational note: even if Stripe restores capacity, we still need to harden retries to avoid hitting quota again. Action items: 1) queue non-critical writes, 2) add circuit-breaker to billing API client, 3) increase backoff and add jitter to webhook retryer, 4) notify product to pause any bulk billing jobs.

Sam (on-call-night): Implementing circuit-breaker patch now. Patch summary: `payments/client: add breaker with 10 req/min threshold and 60s cooldown`. Rolling to canary 14:52 UTC.

Anika (payments): Paused bulk billing jobs and client-side retries at 14:48 UTC. Dashboard shows webhook retry rate down by 78% in next 5m. Partial customer relief — many checkouts progressing using cached entitlements.

Maya (support): Logging updated status to status.redwood.ai: "Partial outage for payments due to third-party quota enforcement. Mitigations in place; checkout may be degraded for impacted customers. ETA: unknown while awaiting Stripe payment/override."

Billing Ops: Finance initiated payment attempt at 14:58 UTC. Stripe acknowledged receipt and started invoice processing. Stripe says an override can be applied but requires escalation.

Stripe Support: (update) We've applied a temporary throttle lift for acct_XXXX while collection is processed. Please monitor for residual 429s. Case updated CS-111332.

Bryce (on-call): Confirming reduced 402 errors and webhooks retrying normally. Marking current status: mitigation successful, system partially restored. Continuing monitoring for recurrence.

Anika (payments): Post-mortem notes to capture later: root cause = failed collection -> Stripe automated quota enforcement; contributing = aggressive webhook retry + bulk billing job running during enforcement; mitigation = payment attempt, retry/backoff, cached-entitlement fallback, circuit-breaker, paused jobs.

Maya (support): Support to follow up high-touch with top affected customers and offer credits where appropriate.

Sam (on-call-night): Handoff summary for next on-call (Sam -> Nora): all mitigation toggles documented in runbook, ticket STR-84021 and CS-111332 linked, monitor key metrics: webhook_429_rate, charge_402_rate, queued_billing_jobs, paid_invoice_status.

Bryce (on-call): Thanks team. I'll draft an incident bulletin and schedule post-mortem. Leaving channel. :thumbsup:

Incident Bot: Handoff: on-call -> Nora at 23:00 UTC.

(End of thread)
